description: Peltier (TEC) module — semi-empirical Q_c, W_in, COP_c using effective Seebeck, electrical resistance, and thermal conductance lumped over a stack of N modules.

unit.name: Generic Bi2Te3 TEC stack — 4 modules in series, ~80 W cooling each
unit.source: Goldsmid, H.J. (2010). Introduction to Thermoelectricity, Springer; Rowe, D.M. (Ed.) (2006). CRC Handbook of Thermoelectrics; Riffat, S.B., Ma, X. (2003). Appl. Thermal Eng. 23, 913-935.

alpha_module.note: Effective Seebeck coefficient per module (~127 thermocouples Bi2Te3)
